co_prescription_discrepancy.mathematical_explanation: The discrepancy between 2,438 drug records and 2,428 unique sequence windows is exactly 375 concurrent co-prescriptions. There are 306 unique 15-minute sequence windows where a patient received 2 different medications simultaneously (e.g. Norepinephrine infusion initiated at the exact same 15-minute mark as Vancomycin or Furosemide). The sequence dataset sets response_valid_mask = 1.0 once per window (2,428 windows), while the event log records each individual medication order (2,438 event entries).
